gloss: poetry anthology; collection of poems or songs

definitions.gloss: poetry anthology; collection of poems or songs
definitions.explanation: A book that collects poems—especially {短歌|たんか} and other Japanese verse—or songs. In classical literature it refers to anthologies of waka such as the {万葉集|まんようしゅう}.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{歌集|かしゅう}を{読|よ}む。
examples.english: to read an old poetry anthology.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{自分|じぶん}の{歌集|かしゅう}を{出版|しゅっぱん}した。
examples.english: She published her own poetry collection.

examples.japanese: この{歌集|かしゅう}には、{四季|しき}を{詠|よ}んだ{美|うつく}しい{短歌|たんか}が{収|おさ}められている。
examples.english: This anthology contains beautiful tanka composed about the four seasons.

notes:
Combines {歌|か} (song, poem) + {集|しゅう} (collection). A collected book of poems—especially {短歌|たんか} and other Japanese verse—or of songs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和歌集|わかしゅう}: anthology of waka poetry
- {歌集|かしゅう}を{編|あ}む: to compile a poetry anthology
- {個人|こじん}{歌集|かしゅう}: a personal poetry collection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {詩集|ししゅう}: poetry collection — for {詩|し} (free verse, modern poetry) rather than traditional {短歌|たんか}
- {句集|くしゅう}: haiku collection — specifically for {俳句|はいく}
